**Finding**: `larch-logs/implement/079BB1E8-1ACF-4CC1-8DFD-328AD7D1485E/` session artifacts committed with status "in-progress".
**Reason not implemented**: Committed larch-logs are the standard /implement workflow pattern — these files are intentionally committed as part of the run and will be updated when the session completes. Not a defect.

**Finding**: Codex prompts no longer size-capped (removed `wc -c < 1200` assertion).
**Reason not implemented**: The removal of the size cap is intentional — Codex prompts now match Cursor's richer output, which is the goal of this PR. The old size limit was a proxy for "short" behavior, not a real safety constraint.

**Finding**: No golden fixture exercises `validate-research-output.sh --structured-reviewer-mode` on realistic combined output.
**Reason not implemented**: Adding a golden fixture test requires new test infrastructure (sample reviewer output files, harness integration). This is genuine follow-up work, not part of the current scope. Would be tracked as a separate OOS issue if substantial, but given complexity it's appropriate to leave as a latent follow-up.
